(26 September 2019) | attendance = 97,291 | average attendance = 2,316 | prevseason = [[2018–19 UAE Pro League|2018–19]] | nextseason = [[2020–21 UAE Pro League|2020–21]] }} The '''2019–20 UAE Pro League''' was the 46th edition of the UAE Pro League. On 26 April 2019, [[Khor Fakkan]] won the first division title over [[Al-Taawon (UAE) Club|Al Taawon]] 3–0; this is their inaugural appearance on the pro league as '''Khor Fakkan Club''' as they were previously known as ''Al Khaleej'', having been absent from the Pro League for twelve years. [[Hatta Club|Hatta]] later returned to the pro league after a 1–0 away victory against [[Al Hamriyah Club|Al Hamriyah]] secured them a spot on the first division after getting relegated a year ago. [[Sharjah FC|Sharjah]] are the defending champions. The League was put on hold on March due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], however on June, with the majority of 12 out of 14 clubs votes, the league was cancelled and the champion is yet to be decided.{{Cite web|url=https://www.thenationalnews.com/sport/football/arabian-gulf-league-season-cancelled-decision-on-champions-awaited-1.1035047|title=Arabian Gulf League season cancelled, decision on champions awaited|date=17 June 2020 |publisher=The National|access-date=17 June 2020}} On 18th of June, it was declared that this season will end with no champion despite [[Shabab Al-Ahli Dubai FC|Shabab Al-Ahli]] leading the table with 43 points and the same teams that qualified for the [[2020 AFC Champions League]] will qualify for the [[2021 AFC Champions League]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.khaleejtimes.com/no-arabian-gulf-league-champion-this-season|title=No Arabian Gulf League champion this season|publisher=Al Khaleej times|access-date=18 June 2020|archive-date=19 June 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200619072414/https://www.khaleejtimes.com/no-arabian-gulf-league-champion-this-season|url-status=dead}} ==Team changes== === To Division 1 === '''Relegated to UAE Division 1''' *[[Emirates Club|Emirates]] *[[Dibba Al-Fujairah Club|Dibba Al Fujairah]] === From Division 1 === '''Promoted to UAE Pro League''' *[[Khor Fakkan Club|Khor Fakkan]] *[[Hatta Club|Hatta]] ==Stadia and locations==
